zone-gray-A: Original small HUD glyph concept. Square image, one centered glyph only, outer bounds within 15-85% of the canvas, uniform solid background #061623. Style: flat printed board-game token language. Die-cut silhouette, constant-width hairline edge, flat print, bold flat glyph. Three tones per element: body, edge, glyph; an outer dark keyline only where the element lies on the board. No gradients, no highlights, no bevels, no embossing, no textures, no drop shadows, no glow, no lens effects, no stone, no parchment, no metal, no bronze. No brush strokes, no ink splatter, no paint splash anywhere. Shape is the first channel, colour is the third: every state must stay readable in grayscale. Family: square dark badge with a coloured disc in the middle. Meaning: zone key gray of a board space. Glyph: a solid square block. Must stay clear at 24, 32 and 48 px. Colours: badge body card.navy #061623, edge card.cream #F9EBDB, disc neutral grey #808080, glyph card.glyph #FAF8F2, keyline mark.keyline #111317. No lettering, no numbers. Forbidden: copying or imitating pixels, assets, splash art, logos, card text or fonts of any commercial digital edition of a board game; brush-stroke banners and ink splatter; invented game data (card names, numbers, hero names, HP, boards, spaces); text, letters or numbers baked into textures; red fills; any element on screen that carries meaning only by colour. Forbidden glyph silhouettes: star, shield, diamond, X, exclamation mark, heart, hexagon, plus sign, triangle, plain circle or ring.
